primary_rule: Pressure minus each presealed static/cap mixture: upper quantile of delay difference < 0 and CV2 difference <= 0; every path physically complete.
calibration_selection: For each simple family, bracket pressure mean executed holding using closest lower/upper calibration means; tie by smaller parameter. Freeze mixture probability to match calibration mean holding. No reweighting on confirmation.
outside_support: If calibration target is outside either family range, retain all calibration results and stop confirmation; no grid expansion.
mixture_estimand: Expected daily endpoint of a fixed ex-ante coin choosing one constant policy for the entire day; evaluate both components on common demand days, never mix trajectories or choose using test outcomes.
